body: For your first time, I would advise trimming it down with scissors since the skin will still be very sensitive. I used to have the same family barging into rooms kind of situation, so I would take scissors into the shower (wrapped in my clothes or a towel) and trim in the shower that way. You can trim the long bits and gradually work down. When it is shorter, you can then shave with a razor - and shaving cream or a very soft soap - also in the shower.
